summary.text: Rodger M. Smitherman represents District 18 (Jefferson County) in the Alabama Senate.

paragraphs.text: According to the Alabama Legislature's profile, he was born in Montgomery, Alabama, on March 2, 1953, and earned a B.B.A. from the University of Montevallo and a Juris Doctor from Miles Law School.
The profile describes him as a practicing attorney who was elected President Pro Tempore of the Alabama Senate on February 5, 2009, and served until November 2, 2010.
